## Resumo A loud neo-brutalist testimonial 'wall of proof' section for a prompt-to-UI design product, set on a warm paper ground (#f4f1ea) with near-black ink (#0a0a0a) and a single electric acid-lime accent (#e8ff00). Top-down: a sticky paper nav with a 3px ink bottom border (an ink tile + acid lightning logo, a JetBrains-Mono PROMPTSMITH wordmark, uppercase mono links, and an acid 'Start free' pill with a hard offset shadow); an ink->acid scrolling marquee strip of star-rating boasts; then the section itself over a dotted-grain texture: a header that pairs a huge four-line Archivo-black headline ('PEOPLE / WHO STOPPED / STARING AT / BLANK CANVAS.' with the last line knocked out as acid-on-ink) with a bordered two-cell stat block (4.9 avg rating | acid 2.1k reviews), a row of filter pills (one solid ink 'All proof' + outlined hover-acid pills), and a responsive 1/2/3-column grid of six testimonial cards. The cards are neo-brutalist panels with 3px ink borders and 6px hard offset shadows: a paper card, an acid feature card, an inverted ink card (acid text + acid hard-shadow), an acid pull-quote card with a giant quote glyph, plus 'via X' and verified-seal trust accents and ink/acid initials avatar tiles. It closes with an inverted ink CTA strip ('GOT A WIN TO SHARE?' + an acid 'Leave a testimonial' pill) carrying an acid hard-shadow. Archivo + JetBrains Mono, Iconify Phosphor icons, a CSS marquee animation. ## Estilo Visual Design a loud neo-brutalist 'wall of proof' testimonial section for a prompt-to-UI SaaS. Pair two Google fonts: Archivo (weights 400-900, the headline/quote 'grotesk') and JetBrains Mono (400/500/700/800, the utilitarian 'mono'). Palette is exactly three values: paper #f4f1ea (background), ink #0a0a0a (text + every border), and ONE accent acid #e8ff00, used only as the feature/inverted-card fills, the knocked-out headline tail, the stat highlight, hover states, avatar tiles and the CTA pill. Use ONLY acid as a hue over paper/ink, never a second color. Build the whole look from heavy borders + hard offset shadows: every card/pill/badge gets border-[3px] border-ink (or border-acid on inverted pieces); define utility shadows .shadow-hard (6px 6px 0 #0a0a0a), .shadow-hard-sm (4px 4px 0 #0a0a0a) and .shadow-hard-acid (6px 6px 0 #e8ff00), all hard with NO blur. Texture the body with a .grain (background-image radial-gradient(#0a0a0a .6px, transparent .6px); background-size 14px 14px) for a riso feel. Headlines are Archivo font-black, leading-[0.9], tracking-tight, very large; quote bodies are Archivo font-bold ~20-24px leading-tight; ALL utility text (nav, bylines, eyebrows, badges, marquee, stats) is JetBrains Mono, small, bold, UPPERCASE, wide tracking (0.12em-0.2em). Knock out emphasis as acid-on-ink via an inline-block span with bg-ink text-acid px-2 box-decoration-clone. Make interaction physical: .card hover translate(-2px,-2px) + shadow grows to 9px 9px 0 ink (or acid on inverted cards); pill/CTA hover translate(+1px,+1px) + shadow-none (pressed). Avatars are 44px square (NOT round) ink/acid tiles with a 3px border and mono extrabold initials. Keep it bold, zine-like, anti-corporate; never soft, never gradient, never rounded-soft. ## Layout e Estrutura ### Sticky paper nav A sticky top header (sticky top-0 z-50) bg-paper #f4f1ea with a border-b-[3px] border-ink. Inside a max-w-[1240px] mx-auto px-6/md:px-10 row, h-[68px], flex items-center justify-between: LEFT = a logo lockup: a grid place-items-center w-8 h-8 bg-ink text-acid border-[3px] border-ink shadow-hard-sm tile holding a ph:lightning-fill, beside a JetBrains-Mono font-extrabold tracking-tight 'PROMPTSMITH' wordmark (text-[17px]). CENTER (hidden md:flex, gap-8, mono text-[13px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wide) = links 'Library', 'Pricing', 'Proof' (#proof), 'Docs', each hover:text-ink/50. RIGHT = an acid 'Start free' pill: mono text-[12px]/md:[13px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide, bg-acid border-[3px] border-ink px-3/md:px-4 py-2 shadow-hard-sm, hover translate-x-[1px] translate-y-[1px] + shadow-none (pressed). ### Marquee rating strip Directly under the nav, a full-bleed bg-ink text-acid strip with a border-b-[3px] border-ink and overflow-hidden. Inside, a flex whitespace-nowrap mono text-[12px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] py-2 row containing a .marquee child (animation: marquee 22s linear infinite, translateX 0 -> -50%) that holds the boast list DUPLICATED back-to-back for a seamless loop: '* 4.9 / 5 average', '* 12,400 designers shipping', '* used by 900+ teams', '* no design degree required' (each in a px-6 span, the leading star a literal acid star glyph). ### Section header + stat block Open a section#proof with class .grain, content in max-w-[1240px] mx-auto px-6/md:px-10 py-16/md:py-24. The header is a flex flex-col -> lg:flex-row lg:items-end lg:justify-between gap-8 mb-12. LEFT (max-w-[680px]): an eyebrow chip = an inline-flex items-center gap-2 mono text-[11px]/md:[12px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] bg-acid border-[3px] border-ink px-3 py-1.5 shadow-hard-sm mb-6, holding a ph:chat-circle-text-fill + 'THE WALL OF PROOF'; then an Archivo font-black leading-[0.9] tracking-tight headline at text-[40px] -> sm:[52px] -> md:[68px] reading on four lines 'PEOPLE' / 'WHO STOPPED' / 'STARING AT' / and a knocked-out tail 'BLANK CANVAS.'. RIGHT = a shrink-0 STAT block: a flex items-stretch border-[3px] border-ink bg-paper shadow-hard mono with two cells: cell 1 (px-5 py-4 text-center, border-r-[3px] border-ink) = a text-[48px]/md:[56px] font-extrabold '4.9', a row of five small ink ph:star-fill, and a text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-ink/55 'avg rating'; cell 2 (px-5 py-4 text-center, bg-acid) = a text-[48px]/md:[56px] font-extrabold '2.1k' over a text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-ink/60 'reviews & counting'. ### Filter pills Below the header, a flex flex-wrap gap-3 mb-10 row of mono text-[12px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide filter buttons, all border-[3px] border-ink px-4 py-2: the first is the ACTIVE state = bg-ink text-paper with a shadow-hard-sm ('All proof'); the rest are bg-paper outlined buttons that go hover:bg-acid on hover ('From devs', 'From founders', 'From designers', 'People who switched'). ### Testimonial grid + card variants A grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 of six neo-brutalist
cards, all border-[3px] border-ink p-6 flex flex-col with a .card hover (translate(-2px,-2px), shadow grows to 9px). FOUR card variants are woven through: (A) PAPER star card = bg-paper shadow-hard: a row of five ink ph:star-fill (mb-4), an Archivo font-bold text-[20px] leading-tight quote, then mt-auto a byline row (pt-5 border-t-[3px] border-ink/15): a 44px square bg-ink text-acid border-[3px] border-ink mono extrabold initials tile + a mono name (font-bold text-[14px]) over an uppercase text-[12px] text-ink/60 role; some bylines add a ph:seal-check-fill text-ink/70 beside the name (verified). (B) ACID FEATURE card = bg-acid shadow-hard with a larger text-[22px] quote plus a secondary mono text-[13px] text-ink/80 paragraph, and an ink avatar tile. (C) INVERTED INK card = bg-ink text-paper shadow-hard-acid with acid ph:star-fill stars, a paper quote, a border-t-[3px] border-paper/20 byline whose avatar is bg-acid text-ink border-acid and whose role is text-paper/60 (uses the .card-acid hover -> acid 9px shadow). (D) PULL-QUOTE acid card = bg-acid justify-between with a giant ph:quotes-fill (text-4xl), an Archivo font-black text-[24px] leading-[1.05] quote, and a byline. Also include a 'via X' trust badge on one card = a mono text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] inline-flex border-[2px] border-ink px-1.5 py-0.5 with a ph:x-logo-bold, pushed opposite the stars; and one half-star (ph:star-half-fill) in a 4.5-rating row. Avatars are ALWAYS 44px SQUARE tiles (w-11 h-11, never round) with a 3px border and mono extrabold initials. ### Inverted CTA strip Below the grid (mt-12), an inverted CTA strip: bg-ink text-paper border-[3px] border-ink shadow-hard-acid p-7/md:p-10, a flex flex-col -> md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between gap-6. LEFT: an Archivo font-black text-[26px] -> sm:[30px] -> md:[34px] leading-[0.95] headline 'GOT A WIN TO SHARE?' (with a sm:hidden
after 'WIN') over a mono text-[12px]/md:[13px] text-paper/70 uppercase tracking-wide subline 'Drop a review. We read every single one.'. RIGHT: a shrink-0 acid CTA pill = mono text-[14px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide bg-acid text-ink border-[3px] border-acid px-6 py-3.5 shadow-hard-sm, hover translate-x/y-[1px] + shadow-none, inline-flex items-center gap-2 'Leave a testimonial' + ph:arrow-right-bold. ## Componentes Especiais de UI ### Componente Hard offset shadow system: .shadow-hard (6px 6px 0 #0a0a0a), .shadow-hard-sm (4px 4px 0 #0a0a0a) and .shadow-hard-acid (6px 6px 0 #e8ff00), all un-blurred so cards read as flat stacked paper ### Componente Physical card hover: .card translates (-2px,-2px) and its hard shadow deepens to 9px 9px 0 ink; the inverted .card-acid variant deepens to 9px 9px 0 acid ### Componente Pressed pill/CTA hover: links and the acid pills translate (+1px,+1px) and drop their shadow to shadow-none, as if physically pressed in ### Componente Acid-on-ink knockout: the headline tail 'BLANK CANVAS.' wrapped in a bg-ink text-acid px-2 box-decoration-clone span so the highlight clones across line breaks ### Componente Ink->acid scrolling marquee strip: a bg-ink text-acid bar whose .marquee child (translateX 0 -> -50%, 22s linear infinite) loops a duplicated list of star-rating boasts ### Componente Two-cell bordered STAT block: a border-[3px] ink box split into a paper '4.9 / avg rating' cell (with five mini stars) and an acid '2.1k / reviews & counting' cell ### Componente Four neo-brutalist card variants woven through one grid: a paper star card, an acid feature card (big quote + secondary paragraph), an inverted ink card (acid stars + acid hard-shadow), and an acid pull-quote card with a giant ph:quotes-fill glyph ### Componente Square (not round) avatar tiles: 44px w-11 h-11 ink/acid tiles with a 3px border and JetBrains-Mono extrabold initials ### Componente Filter pill row: a solid ink 'All proof' active pill plus outlined pills that flip to bg-acid on hover ### Componente 'via X' trust badge + verified seal: a bordered mono 'via X' badge (ph:x-logo-bold) on one card and a ph:seal-check-fill beside a verified reviewer's name ### Componente Half-star rating: a ph:star-half-fill closing one card's star row for a 4.5 rating ### Componente Dotted .grain texture: 0.6px ink radial dots on a 14px grid behind the proof section for a risograph feel ### Componente Inverted ink CTA strip with an acid hard-shadow and an acid 'Leave a testimonial' pill ## Notas Especiais Fonts via Google Fonts: Archivo (weights 400/500/600/700/800/900, mapped to fontFamily.grotesk, used for headlines + quote bodies) and JetBrains Mono (weights 400/500/700/800, mapped to fontFamily.mono, used for all nav/byline/eyebrow/badge/marquee/stat text). Styled with Tailwind via CDN using a custom theme with exactly three colors: paper #f4f1ea, ink #0a0a0a, acid #e8ff00. Body background #f4f1ea. Custom CSS: html scroll-behavior smooth; the hard-shadow utilities .shadow-hard (6px 6px 0 0 #0a0a0a), .shadow-hard-sm (4px 4px 0 0 #0a0a0a), .shadow-hard-acid (6px 6px 0 0 #e8ff00); .card transition transform .14s + box-shadow .14s with .card:hover translate(-2px,-2px) + box-shadow 9px 9px 0 0 #0a0a0a, and .card-acid:hover box-shadow 9px 9px 0 0 #e8ff00; .grain background-image radial-gradient(#0a0a0a 0.6px, transparent 0.6px) at background-size 14px 14px; and a .marquee keyframe (from translateX(0) to translateX(-50%)) running 22s linear infinite. Icons are the Iconify runtime (code.iconify.design) rendering Phosphor (ph:) icons: lightning-fill, chat-circle-text-fill, star-fill, star-half-fill, quotes-fill, x-logo-bold, seal-check-fill, arrow-right-bold. There is effectively no JS beyond the CSS marquee animation; nav links and pills are static anchors. The signature moves are the single electric acid-lime accent over warm paper + near-black ink, the heavy 3px borders with hard un-blurred offset shadows (including acid shadows on the inverted/feature beats), the physical translate-on-hover interaction, the acid-on-ink knocked-out headline tail, the four distinct neo-brutalist card variants in one grid, and the scrolling ink->acid rating marquee. Keep the palette strictly acid over paper/ink, never add a second hue; keep every shadow hard and offset, never blurred; keep avatars square, never round; keep the voice bold, zine-like and anti-corporate.

style.description: A confident neo-brutalist / 'acid editorial' style: warm off-white paper (#f4f1ea) ground, near-black ink (#0a0a0a) text and borders, and exactly ONE hyper-saturated accent, electric acid-lime #e8ff00, used for the feature card, the knocked-out headline tail, the stat highlight, hover states, avatars and the CTA pill. The whole system is built from heavy 3px ink borders (border-[3px] border-ink) and HARD, un-blurred offset box-shadows (6px 6px 0 ink for cards, 4px 4px 0 ink for small pills, 6px 6px 0 acid for the inverted/feature beats), never a soft blur, so everything reads as flat stacked paper. Type is a deliberate two-face pairing: Archivo (the 'grotesk', up to weight 900 / black) for headlines and quote bodies set tight (leading 0.9-1.1, tracking-tight), and JetBrains Mono (the 'mono') for everything utilitarian: nav links, byline names/roles, eyebrows, badges, the marquee and the stat numbers, all small, bold, UPPERCASE and wide-tracked (tracking-[0.12em]-[0.2em]). The page is textured with a faint dotted '.grain' (0.6px ink radial dots on a 14px grid) for a risograph feel. Interaction is physical: cards translate -2px,-2px and deepen their hard shadow to 9px on hover; pills/links nudge +1px,+1px and drop their shadow as if pressed. Mood: bold, punchy, a little zine/poster, high craft, anti-corporate; never soft, never gradient-y. Color discipline: only acid-lime as a hue over the paper/ink neutrals, strictly no second accent color.

structured.special_notes: Fonts via Google Fonts: Archivo (weights 400/500/600/700/800/900, mapped to fontFamily.grotesk, used for headlines + quote bodies) and JetBrains Mono (weights 400/500/700/800, mapped to fontFamily.mono, used for all nav/byline/eyebrow/badge/marquee/stat text). Styled with Tailwind via CDN using a custom theme with exactly three colors: paper #f4f1ea, ink #0a0a0a, acid #e8ff00. Body background #f4f1ea. Custom CSS: html scroll-behavior smooth; the hard-shadow utilities .shadow-hard (6px 6px 0 0 #0a0a0a), .shadow-hard-sm (4px 4px 0 0 #0a0a0a), .shadow-hard-acid (6px 6px 0 0 #e8ff00); .card transition transform .14s + box-shadow .14s with .card:hover translate(-2px,-2px) + box-shadow 9px 9px 0 0 #0a0a0a, and .card-acid:hover box-shadow 9px 9px 0 0 #e8ff00; .grain background-image radial-gradient(#0a0a0a 0.6px, transparent 0.6px) at background-size 14px 14px; and a .marquee keyframe (from translateX(0) to translateX(-50%)) running 22s linear infinite. Icons are the Iconify runtime (code.iconify.design) rendering Phosphor (ph:) icons: lightning-fill, chat-circle-text-fill, star-fill, star-half-fill, quotes-fill, x-logo-bold, seal-check-fill, arrow-right-bold. There is effectively no JS beyond the CSS marquee animation; nav links and pills are static anchors. The signature moves are the single electric acid-lime accent over warm paper + near-black ink, the heavy 3px borders with hard un-blurred offset shadows (including acid shadows on the inverted/feature beats), the physical translate-on-hover interaction, the acid-on-ink knocked-out headline tail, the four distinct neo-brutalist card variants in one grid, and the scrolling ink->acid rating marquee. Keep the palette strictly acid over paper/ink, never add a second hue; keep every shadow hard and offset, never blurred; keep avatars square, never round; keep the voice bold, zine-like and anti-corporate.
